items.label: JCET annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-10-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Capex and construction in progress (annual report): cash paid

set.signal: Capex and construction in progress (annual report): cash paid for fixed and other long-term assets RMB 6,298,299,227.33 in 2025, up 37.19%; construction in progress RMB 3,894,315,261.29 at end-2025, up 36.37%, mainly capacity investment at JCET Automotive Electronics and JSCK (Korea) and headquarters R&D investment. Major projects: JCET automotive chip packaging-and-test project, budget RMB 8,000,000,000.00, cumulative investment 8.53% of budget (self-funded); wafer-level microsystem integration high-end manufacturing project, budget RMB 3,800,000,000.00, 88.01% of budget. Raised-fund projects: the 10-billion-units-a-year communications high-density hybrid IC and module packaging project reached its intended usable state in December 2025 (plant built, capacity expanded) and generated total profit of RMB 4,916.05 ten-thousand in 2025; the 3.6-billion-units-a-year high-density IC and SiP module project completed plant construction and part of its equipment purchase.

items.reason: Drop the clause on RMB 210,000.00 ten-thousand of raised funds redirected to buying 80% of Shengdie: use of proceeds / acquisition consideration (skill §2 financing terms; acquisition price never captured). Rest verified verbatim.
